settings.v_ingredients_text:
1/2 lb 80/20 ground beef
1 tsp coarse kosher salt
1/2 tsp black pepper
2 brioche buns, buttered
2 slices sharp cheddar
1 tbsp neutral oil or tallow
settings.v_steps_text:
Divide beef into two loose 4-oz balls. Do not overwork.
Heat cast iron until lightly smoking with thin oil layer.
Place beef in skillet, smash flat immediately.
Season with salt & pepper. Cook 2-3 min for deep crust.
Flip, top with cheese, cover 1 min to melt.
Toast buns, assemble, rest 2 min and serve.
